question: 4 people A, B, C and D are sitting in a straight line, facing north. A and C are not sitting adjacent to each other, while C and B are sitting adjacent to each other. Which of the following sitting arrangements is NOT possible?
solution:
Given conditions of the seating arrangement:

 
• 4 people: A, B, C, and D are sitting in a straight line facing north.
 
• A and C are not sitting adjacent to each other.
 
• C and B are sitting adjacent to each other.

**Option 1)** DABC → Possible (Follows all the conditions)
